ecological_question: Do regional climate-winner/loser trends among Pygoscelis penguins arise through local species replacement within shared breeding sites, or mainly through spatial sorting among sites?

geographic_domain.reason: The Antarctic Peninsula/South Shetland region where the established regional contrast is Gentoo increase/range expansion versus widespread Adélie and Chinstrap decline.

matched-season-rule.eligibility: Both species in the pair must each have at least one finite nest-count record at the same site and same APBP season.
matched-season-rule.missing_rule: Missing species records are never converted to zero.
matched-season-rule.within_site_species_season_value: median of log1p(count) across all finite nest-count records for that site x species x season; this rule is fixed before count trends are computed.
matched-season-rule.reason: Exact season matching prevents different temporal sampling windows from creating an apparent cross-species replacement signal.

gate0_outputs_only: number of eligible site trajectories for each frozen species pair
distribution of shared-season counts and time spans
no species slopes, trend signs, correlations or count magnitudes beyond metadata needed for eligibility

gate0_pass_rule.decision: Primary effect estimation proceeds only if ADPE-GEPE has >=12 eligible sites. CHPE-GEPE is inferential secondary only if it independently has >=12. Context ADPE-CHPE has no blocking threshold.
gate0_pass_rule.terminal: Do not lower 5 shared seasons, 10-year span, 12-site threshold, or geographic domain after seeing coverage.

effect_design_if_primary_gate_passes.site_level_trend: OLS slope of median log1p nest count versus centered season, fit separately by species using the exact same matched seasons within each site.
effect_design_if_primary_gate_passes.primary_statistic: Spearman correlation across sites between ADPE slope and GEPE slope.
effect_design_if_primary_gate_passes.primary_inference: exact permutation if n! is computationally tractable, otherwise 100000 permutations with seed 20261001, shuffling GEPE site slopes among sites while preserving the paired species slope vectors and site set.
effect_design_if_primary_gate_passes.mandatory_effect_size: observed Spearman rho plus bootstrap 95% interval over sites; permutation p-value is directional and secondary to effect magnitude.
effect_design_if_primary_gate_passes.replacement_strength_secondary: For sites where ADPE slope < 0 and GEPE slope > 0, report the fraction for which GEPE absolute nest gain offsets at least 25% of ADPE absolute nest loss over the shared observed interval; this is descriptive only and cannot rescue a failed primary correlation.

interpretation_rules: A negative correlation supports coordinated local replacement but not direct competition.
A null/positive correlation, if sufficiently precise, supports regional spatial sorting rather than simple one-for-one local replacement.
Do not infer climate causality from the cross-species trend pairing alone.
Do not use proportions or community shares as the primary response because their negative covariance is partly compositional by construction.
Do not select sites based on observed trend direction.
provenance_note: MAPPPD count magnitudes have been opened in prior mina analyses, so this is a newly frozen ecological synthesis test, not a claim of pristine preregistration. The specific matched-site cross-species trend statistic has not been computed before this contract.
